hook: Paul's second letter to the Thessalonians.
intro: Second Thessalonians follows soon after the first letter, to clear up confusion about the day of the Lord.
Chapter one encourages them in persecution. Chapter two explains events that must come first. Chapter three tells them to keep working, and not grow weary in doing good.
Paul wrote it to the same young church.
Listen for: be not weary in well doing.

card.parts: Ch. 1: encouragement | Ch. 2: the day of the Lord | Ch. 3: keep working
